notes.title: Update for July 21
notes.content: New music in the standard rotation

notes.title: Update for June 12th
notes.content: Fix a bug where users could not publish ghosts correctly. The VAST majority of users have been effected by this since the last major patch. Sorry, my bad.

notes.title: Update for April 29th
notes.content: Fix for the performance issues seen in the last update.

notes.title: Update for April 27th
notes.content: Made some adjustments to the way the game scales at high resolutions. Should increase the amount of play area visible for all players.

notes.title: Update for April 12th
notes.content:
Added the ability to customise your controls.
Added an option for single button controls. When "release to detach" is set your tether will only stay attached as long as the attach button is held down. This means that the tether will always be retracting while attached. I wouldn't recommend it, but some players can't use two buttons comfortably.

notes.title: Update for August 14th
notes.content: Fixed bug that caused invisible blocks to spawn (such as in today's race).

notes.title: Update for Febuary 12th
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused score retrieval to hang in some circumstances

notes.title: Update for February 2nd
notes.content:
New music in the standard rotation
A new achievement for reaching maximum speed

notes.title: Update for January 24th
notes.content:
The world generator has undergone some changes. This will mean that the starting locations are more varied, and that walls of blocks are less likely to form. World seeds from previous game versions will retain the same feel, but individual block placement will not be exactly the same.

The "show tether tension" option now more clearly shows any slack in the tether. Anyone struggling with tether behaviour should try this setting out.

Added the "aim assist" setting. With this turned on, the game will search for blocks in a 6 degree arc instead of requiring exact hits.

Added an effect when the player gets to maximum velocity.

Fixed visual bugs with the player trail.

notes.title: Update for January 7th
notes.content:
Date localisation bug fixed
Due to the above bug, the daily race race leaderboards  have been reset.

notes.title: Update for January 5th
notes.content:
Made tether tension more obvious when setting is enabled
